name: Scrolling document
description: A longer passage types at a readable size while the window follows the caret.

values.code:
Before you share

Start with one clear idea.
Write for the person reading.
Choose words you would say aloud.

Give the window a purpose.
Leave room around the text.
Keep the title short.

Let the pointer arrive.
Pause before the first word.
Give each line time to land.

Read the result once more.
Remove what does not help.
Keep the details that matter.

Then share the finished scene.
